title: More monatomic gas
hook: Change amount of gas and predict internal energy.
misconception: internal energy stays fixed when amount of gas doubles.
objective: Apply U = 3nRT/2 to compare internal energy when amount of gas changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a monatomic ideal gas at fixed absolute temperature, U = 3nRT/2. When amount of gas doubles, internal energy becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model U = 3nRT/2; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a monatomic ideal gas at fixed absolute temperature, with a nonzero initial result. If amount of gas triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on internal energy?
recall.why: Apply U = 3nRT/2 under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
